svg.text: // open source // better dev tools // keep building...
I build backend systems and developer tooling,
I'm a software developer who builds in the open. My work sits where Web3, developer tooling, and the cloud meet: SDKs,
backend services, and infrastructure that other developers rely on. I care about clean APIs, readable code, and systems that
keep running after they ship. I like digging into how things work under the hood, from smart contracts and protocols to
containers and distributed systems, and turning that into tools that make development simpler. Most of what I know I've
learned by contributing to open source, and I give back the same way: through code, docs, reviews, and helping new
